#### **Crowley Mariners Honored with Gallant Ship Award on National Maritime Day**

Crowley mariners who served aboard the U.S.-flagged tanker Stena Immaculate were honored with the
U.S. Maritime Administration’s (MARAD) Gallant Ship Award during the U.S. Department of
Transportation’s National Maritime Day observance in Washington, D.C. The award, one of the maritime
industry’s highest distinctions, recognizes the 23-member crew’s extraordinary professionalism,
courage and commitment to safety.

[Read the Full press Release>][72]

#### **Crowley’s First Avance Class Vessel Quetzal Begins Maiden Commercial Voyage**

Crowley’s new LNG-powered containership Quetzal has successfully begun its inaugural commercial
voyage, opening the company’s next era of faster, frequent ocean shipping with a new class of
vessels for the U.S., Central America and the Dominican Republic.

With capacity for up to 1,400 20-foot container equivalent units (TEUs), Quetzal and its three
forthcoming sister Avance Class ships will provide more cargo capacity while using lower-emissions
liquefied natural gas (LNG) for fuel. Quetzal and its sister ships were specifically designed to
accommodate a variety of container sizes, including 300 refrigerated container unit plugs.

[Read More >][73]

# Transporting Offshore Leadership Around the Globe

### Global. Diversified. Sustainable. Safety-first. This is SEACOR Marine.

SEACOR Marine provides global marine and support transportation services to offshore energy
industries, predominantly oil and gas exploration and production, and offshore wind. We operate and
manage a diverse energy-efficient fleet of offshore support vessels, focusing on safety, reliability
and environmentally sustainable practices.

Throughout the world, companies rely on SEACOR Marine for a diverse range of industry-leading
offshore transport solutions such as crew transportation, supply, accommodation and maintenance
support. Our geographic reach spans five continents, ensuring access to all major offshore oil and
gas markets and unmatched availability. With one of the largest and most diverse fleet of offshore
marine support vessels, we deliver a complete suite of transport services to meet the full lifecycle
needs of offshore energy. Whether offshore or onshore, safety drives our operations everywhere,
every day.

Providing sustainable marine services and towage infrastructure

## Leading sustainable marine services

Founded in 1833, Svitzer builds on almost 200 years of experience, and our powerful tugboats and
experts in towage work tirelessly to keep goods flowing, businesses thriving, and communities
connected. Today, Svitzer is a leading global port and terminal infrastructure provider, serving
approximately 2,000 customers in 157 ports and 46 terminals across 38 countries through a fleet of
510 vessels.

Consent Required

Update Cookie Settings

## TRAnsverse tug: Redefining Towage

With its revolutionary design, Svitzer’s TRAnsverse tug takes manoeuvrability and towing
capabilities to the next level.
Read the evidence in the White Paper, which includes data from sea trials and from the tug’s
operations.
At speeds above 2-3 knots in dynamic modes, the TRAnsverse tug expands the operating envelope by
around 50% compared to similar or larger size standard ASD tug designs. Further, the TRAnsverse tug
has shown a fuel efficiency gain of 15%.
The TRAnsverse tug: Redefining towage and only possible with Svitzer.

[ Learn more about the Svitzer TRAnsverse Tug here ][19]

Partnering for growth and safety at Latin America’s largest port

## Partnering for growth and safety at Latin America’s largest port

Over the years, Svitzer and the Port of Santos have grown side by side, scaling up their operations
to respond to increasing demand. As trade volumes continue to soar at this pivotal hub in Latin
America, Svitzer and the Port have continued to consolidate their partnership to support Brazil’s
position as the third largest economy in the Americas – and the largest in the southern hemisphere.

Supporting a regional energy gateway in Greece

## Supporting a regional energy gateway in Greece

Svitzer is applying it’s international global terminal towage expertise and experience to support
Gastrade’s Alexandroupolis Independent Natural Gas System (Alexandroupolis INGS) LNG terminal, the
first offshore LNG project in Greece. Svitzer has worked closely and listened deeply to provide a
truly customised solution for Gastrade, with the delivery of four brand new tugs operated by our
local Greek team.

## ESG

At ADNOC L&S, ESG is a core operational and strategic priority. As a leading provider of maritime
logistics and services, we maintain a deeply rooted connection to the nation’s rich seafaring
maritime heritage and sustainability is deeply held within the DNA of our company. We are fully
aligned with the International Maritime Organization strategy for greenhouse gas emissions and are
making major contributions to ADNOC Group’s 2045 Net Zero target and the UAE’s Net Zero 2050
strategy. Since 2023, we have committed $6.25 billion toward LNG carriers and dual-fuel vessels,
driving significant improvements in fleet energy efficiency and supporting our emissions reduction
goals and reduced the carbon intensity of our shipping operations by 56% since 2019.

## CÔNG TY CỔ PHẦN HÀNG HẢI VÀ THƯƠNG MẠI BIỂN XANH

### *An toàn – Chuyên nghiệp – Tin cậy – Hiệu Quả*

Tự hào là đối tác cung cấp dịch vụ hàng hải và logistics đáng tin cậy của bạn. Với đội ngũ chuyên
gia, nhân viên giàu kinh nghiệm, nhiệt huyết và mạng lưới dịch vụ toàn cầu, chúng tôi cung cấp các
dịch vụ hàng hải toàn diện từ vận chuyển hàng hóa, lai dắt hỗ trợ tàu biển, đại lý tàu biển, cung
ứng nhiên liệu – vật tư – nước ngọt đến các dịch vụ logistics chuyên nghiệp. Chúng tôi cam kết luôn
mang đến dịch vụ an toàn, chất lượng và tối ưu nhất cho mọi nhu cầu của khách hàng.

[ Xem chi tiết ][21]

## DỊCH VỤ CHÚNG TÔI

### [Dịch Vụ Lai Dắt Và Hỗ Trợ Tàu Biển][22]

Với đội tàu lai dắt hiện đại và đội ngũ thuyền viên dày dạn kinh nghiệm, Chúng tôi đảm bảo hỗ trợ
các tàu ra vào cảng, neo đậu và xử lý các tình huống trên biển một cách an toàn và hiệu quả nhất.

### [Vận Chuyển Hàng Hóa Trong Và Ngoài Nước][23]

Cung cấp giải pháp vận chuyển hàng hóa đường biển toàn diện, kết nối nội địa và quốc tế. Chúng tôi
cam kết lộ trình tối ưu, thời gian nhanh chóng và chi phí cạnh tranh cho mọi lô hàng.

### [Đại Lý Hàng Hải                                                        ][24]

Cung cấp dịch vụ đại lý chuyên nghiệp cho các hãng tàu tại tất cả các cảng biển Việt Nam, bao gồm
thủ tục cảng vụ, cung ứng, thay đổi thuyền viên và hỗ trợ toàn diện cho tàu và thuyền bộ.

### [Thuê Và Cho Thuê Tàu Biển                 ][25]

Chúng tôi là cầu nối tin cậy giữa chủ tàu và người thuê tàu, cung cấp dịch vụ môi giới, đàm phán và
ký kết hợp đồng thuê tàu (tàu dầu, tàu khí hóa lỏng, tàu hóa chất, tàu hàng rời, tàu container..)
với các điều khoản tốt nhất.

### [Quản Lý Và Khai Thác Tàu                    ][26]

Cung cấp dịch vụ quản lý kỹ thuật, quản lý thuyền viên và khai thác thương mại cho đội tàu của bạn.
Đảm bảo tàu hoạt động an toàn, hiệu quả và tuân thủ các tiêu chuẩn quốc tế.

### [Các Dịch Vụ Logistics Khác][27]

Ngoài ra, chúng tôi còn cung cấp các giải pháp Logistics tích hợp như dịch vụ kho cảng, bãi, thủ tục
hải quan, vận tải đa phương thức, đáp ứng mọi nhu cầu trong chuỗi cung ứng của khách hàng.

Logistics.

[ Công ty có cung cấp dịch vụ đại lý vận chuyển quốc tế không? ][35]

Có. **CÔNG TY CỔ PHẦN HÀNG HẢI VÀ THƯƠNG MẠI BIỂN XANH** tự hào cung cấp dịch vụ đại lý vận chuyển
quốc tế chuyên nghiệp và đáng tin cậy. **BIỂN XANH** hiểu rằng vận chuyển quốc tế là một phần quan
trọng trong chuỗi cung ứng toàn cầu của nhiều doanh nghiệp, và chúng tôi cam kết mang đến giải pháp
vận chuyển tối ưu nhất.

Dưới đây là những gì chúng tôi cung cấp trong dịch vụ đại lý vận chuyển quốc tế:
* **Hỗ trợ Booking:** **BIỂN XANH** giúp khách hàng đặt chỗ trên các chuyến tàu, máy bay hoặc phương
  tiện vận tải khác, đảm bảo việc vận chuyển hàng hóa diễn ra suôn sẻ và đúng lịch trình.
* **Xử lý thủ tục hải quan:** Đội ngũ chuyên gia của **BIỂN XANH** sẽ hỗ trợ bạn trong việc chuẩn bị
  và hoàn tất các thủ tục hải quan phức tạp, đảm bảo hàng hóa của bạn được thông quan nhanh chóng và
  tuân thủ mọi quy định pháp luật.
* **Quản lý vận tải đa phương thức:** Đại lý vận chuyển **BIỂN XANH** cung cấp các giải pháp vận tải
  kết hợp nhiều phương thức như đường biển, đường bộ và đường hàng không, giúp tối ưu hóa thời gian
  và chi phí vận chuyển.
* **Theo dõi và báo cáo:** Chúng tôi cung cấp dịch vụ theo dõi và báo cáo chi tiết về tình trạng
  hàng hóa, giúp khách hàng dễ dàng giám sát và kiểm soát quá trình vận chuyển.
* **Tư vấn chuyên nghiệp:** Với kinh nghiệm dày dặn và kiến thức sâu rộng, chúng tôi sẵn sàng tư vấn
  và đưa ra giải pháp vận chuyển phù hợp nhất với nhu cầu và ngân sách của bạn.

## CÔNG TY CỔ PHẦN HÀNG HẢI VÀ THƯƠNG MẠI BIỂN XANH

### *An toàn – Chuyên nghiệp – Tin cậy – Hiệu Quả*

Tự hào là đối tác cung cấp dịch vụ hàng hải và logistics đáng tin cậy của bạn. Với đội ngũ chuyên
gia, nhân viên giàu kinh nghiệm, nhiệt huyết và mạng lưới dịch vụ toàn cầu, chúng tôi cung cấp các
dịch vụ hàng hải toàn diện từ vận chuyển hàng hóa, lai dắt hỗ trợ tàu biển, đại lý tàu biển, cung
ứng nhiên liệu – vật tư – nước ngọt đến các dịch vụ logistics chuyên nghiệp. Chúng tôi cam kết luôn
mang đến dịch vụ an toàn, chất lượng và tối ưu nhất cho mọi nhu cầu của khách hàng.

[ Xem chi tiết ][21]

## DỊCH VỤ CHÚNG TÔI

### [Dịch Vụ Lai Dắt Và Hỗ Trợ Tàu Biển][22]

Với đội tàu lai dắt hiện đại và đội ngũ thuyền viên dày dạn kinh nghiệm, Chúng tôi đảm bảo hỗ trợ
các tàu ra vào cảng, neo đậu và xử lý các tình huống trên biển một cách an toàn và hiệu quả nhất.

### [Vận Chuyển Hàng Hóa Trong Và Ngoài Nước][23]

Cung cấp giải pháp vận chuyển hàng hóa đường biển toàn diện, kết nối nội địa và quốc tế. Chúng tôi
cam kết lộ trình tối ưu, thời gian nhanh chóng và chi phí cạnh tranh cho mọi lô hàng.

### [Đại Lý Hàng Hải                                                        ][24]

Cung cấp dịch vụ đại lý chuyên nghiệp cho các hãng tàu tại tất cả các cảng biển Việt Nam, bao gồm
thủ tục cảng vụ, cung ứng, thay đổi thuyền viên và hỗ trợ toàn diện cho tàu và thuyền bộ.

### [Thuê Và Cho Thuê Tàu Biển                 ][25]

Chúng tôi là cầu nối tin cậy giữa chủ tàu và người thuê tàu, cung cấp dịch vụ môi giới, đàm phán và
ký kết hợp đồng thuê tàu (tàu dầu, tàu khí hóa lỏng, tàu hóa chất, tàu hàng rời, tàu container..)
với các điều khoản tốt nhất.

### [Quản Lý Và Khai Thác Tàu                    ][26]

Cung cấp dịch vụ quản lý kỹ thuật, quản lý thuyền viên và khai thác thương mại cho đội tàu của bạn.
Đảm bảo tàu hoạt động an toàn, hiệu quả và tuân thủ các tiêu chuẩn quốc tế.

### [Các Dịch Vụ Logistics Khác][27]

Ngoài ra, chúng tôi còn cung cấp các giải pháp Logistics tích hợp như dịch vụ kho cảng, bãi, thủ tục
hải quan, vận tải đa phương thức, đáp ứng mọi nhu cầu trong chuỗi cung ứng của khách hàng.

Logistics.

Với đội ngũ chuyên gia, nhân viên chuyên nghiệp, giàu kinh nghiệm và tinh thần trách nhiệm cao,

[ Công ty có cung cấp dịch vụ đại lý vận chuyển quốc tế không? ][35]

Có. **CÔNG TY CỔ PHẦN HÀNG HẢI VÀ THƯƠNG MẠI BIỂN XANH** tự hào cung cấp dịch vụ đại lý vận chuyển
quốc tế chuyên nghiệp và đáng tin cậy. **BIỂN XANH** hiểu rằng vận chuyển quốc tế là một phần quan
trọng trong chuỗi cung ứng toàn cầu của nhiều doanh nghiệp, và chúng tôi cam kết mang đến giải pháp
vận chuyển tối ưu nhất.

Dưới đây là những gì chúng tôi cung cấp trong dịch vụ đại lý vận chuyển quốc tế:
* **Hỗ trợ Booking:** **BIỂN XANH** giúp khách hàng đặt chỗ trên các chuyến tàu, máy bay hoặc phương
  tiện vận tải khác, đảm bảo việc vận chuyển hàng hóa diễn ra suôn sẻ và đúng lịch trình.
* **Xử lý thủ tục hải quan:** Đội ngũ chuyên gia của **BIỂN XANH** sẽ hỗ trợ bạn trong việc chuẩn bị
  và hoàn tất các thủ tục hải quan phức tạp, đảm bảo hàng hóa của bạn được thông quan nhanh chóng và
  tuân thủ mọi quy định pháp luật.
* **Quản lý vận tải đa phương thức:** Đại lý vận chuyển **BIỂN XANH** cung cấp các giải pháp vận tải
  kết hợp nhiều phương thức như đường biển, đường bộ và đường hàng không, giúp tối ưu hóa thời gian
  và chi phí vận chuyển.
* **Theo dõi và báo cáo:** Chúng tôi cung cấp dịch vụ theo dõi và báo cáo chi tiết về tình trạng
  hàng hóa, giúp khách hàng dễ dàng giám sát và kiểm soát quá trình vận chuyển.

# Marine Services Company Dubai UAE

Dexter Offshore is the leading Dubai marine company. Our international client base trusts our ship
management services because of our integrity, directness, and flexibility.

[View Our Services][19] [Download Brochure][20]

## Ship Lay-up

We have developed a safe and cold stacking area for shallow water vessels and barges in the UAE

[Learn More][21]

## Ship Chartering

We charter a variety of owned and operated vessels needed for EPC and Civil marine projects

[Learn More][22]

## Marine Salvage

We salvage ships and their cargoes when at risk and we remove wrecks and their hydrocarbons
protecting the environment.

[Learn More][23]

Ship management is a challenging endeavor involving carrying out crucial tasks throughout the ship
operation. An excellent marine company needs to cover the necessary ship approval in conformance to
local requirements, aside from the actual management of the vessel.

Here at **Dexter Offshore**, we have an extensive understanding and experience in offshore ship
management, including local operating requirements in the Middle East, India, Far East, South East
Asia, West Africa, and East Africa.

We align our priorities and risks with our clients, providing them the confidence and certainty to
always stay one step ahead.

[Discover More][24]

### Contact us today and discover how Dexter Offshore can help your business reach greater heights.

## Most Trusted Dubai Marine Company

[Dexter Offshore shipping company Dubai]

Founded by a group of marine professionals in 2012, Dexter Offshore embodies their passion and
business values. Known for its direct approach and flexibility in problem-solving, our company
offers top-quality [vessel chartering][25], [sea storage facilities][26], and other related
services.

Since we have a lean and well-managed organisation, our response to any situation is always quick
and efficient. We work with a widespread network of correspondent offices. Plus, our crew in charge
of the charters is readily available within the area of chartering activities.

## Our Top-Quality Marine Services

As one of the leading marine companies in Dubai and the UAE, Dexter Offshore provides the following
maritime support services with the flexibility to align with our customer’s specific needs.

[ship chartering Dubai]

### Ship Chartering

We have a variety of [vessels][27] to cater to either EPC or marine civil projects, such as 10,000
DWT Barge, diving support vessel, marine balloon pontoon, and workboats. Our team of experts assists
throughout the whole process, which starts with helping our clients pick the suitable ship depending
on the type of cargo, nature of the operation, and shipping destinations.

Our multinational clients trust us because we can always secure a suitable vessel for their
operation fast. They rely on our expertise, reputation, and extensive contacts in the industry.

[uae marine salvage company]

### Marine Salvage

Quick response is critical in mitigating environmental damage caused by distressed or sunken
vessels. Our team has the resources and expertise to handle the challenges of removing wrecks and
their hydrocarbons while keeping the marine environments safe during recovery.

Our years of experience assisting international salvage companies helped us navigate the
complexities of maritime law and government regulations. We can even assist with small local
[salvage and wreck removal][28] projects.

[lay up sea storage facility for shallow water vessels barges]

### Ship Lay Up

We offer a cold and warm lay up sea storage facility for shallow water vessels and barges in Dubai.
Our team works closely with [local authorities][29] to ensure the vessels’ safe and secure stacking.

Our cost-effective ship [lay up services][30] ensure lower berthing fees than traditional ports. We
also help quickly process security passes and CID clearance and provide an in-house maintenance team
and marine surveillance.

### Partner with the Best Marine Company in UAE

Dexter Offshore offers clients more than the usual standard chartering services compared to other
marine offshore companies in UAE. Businesses who want safe and efficient maritime operations rely on
our services because of our expertise, professionalism, and values.

[***Contact us today***][31]*** and discover how Dexter Offshore can help your business reach
greater heights.***

[Dexter Offshore Ltd - Dubai, United Arab Emirates]

### DEXTER OFFSHORE LTD

Fathom.ai is a free AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes, and summarizes calls on Zoom,
Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams. The company was founded in 2020 by Richard White, a computer
science engineer who previously co-built UserVoice over roughly 12 years, scaling it to $10 million
in revenue before transitioning out in 2019. Fathom has grown from $100K ARR in 2022 to $1M in 2023,
$10M in 2024, and $30M in 2025, a trajectory White describes as "zero to one, one to 10, and 10 to
30 in the first three years of monetization." The company has raised $30 million total across three
rounds, including a $10M seed in 2021, a $3M seed in 2023, and a $17M Series A in 2024 at a $73M
valuation. The team has grown to 100 people. Average revenue per customer is approximately $25 per
seat with an average of 8 to 10 seats, putting the typical account around $200 per month. The single
most distinctive strategic fact is that Fathom gave its core product away for free even while losing
$50 per user per month in its early years, betting that transcription costs would fall to near zero.

product, allowing Fathom to reach hundreds of thousands of daily users and $30M ARR while raising
far less capital than any of its major competitors.

Fathom.ai is a free AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes, and summarizes calls on Zoom,
Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams. The company was founded in 2020 by Richard White, a computer
science engineer who previously co-built UserVoice over roughly 12 years, scaling it to $10 million
in revenue before transitioning out in 2019. Fathom has grown from $100K ARR in 2022 to $1M in 2023,
$10M in 2024, and $30M in 2025, a trajectory White describes as "zero to one, one to 10, and 10 to
30 in the first three years of monetization." The company has raised $30 million total across three
rounds, including a $10M seed in 2021, a $3M seed in 2023, and a $17M Series A in 2024 at a $73M
valuation. The team has grown to 100 people. Average revenue per customer is approximately $25 per
seat with an average of 8 to 10 seats, putting the typical account around $200 per month. The single
most distinctive strategic fact is that Fathom gave its core product away for free even while losing
$50 per user per month in its early years, betting that transcription costs would fall to near zero.
That bet proved correct, and the free individual tier became the distribution engine for a paid team
product, allowing Fathom to reach hundreds of thousands of daily users and $30M ARR while raising
far less capital than any of its major competitors.

per day, converted roughly 2,500 new paid customers in its most recent month, and carries a monthly

value, accounts for more than 10,000 active affiliates and directly drives 20% of total revenue. The
single most striking strategic fact is that SubMagic scaled from zero to $8M ARR in two years with
13 employees, generating roughly $700,000 of revenue per employee, by combining precise timing with
the short-form content boom, a generous affiliate program launched within 30 days of its first

FlipCX, formerly RedRoute and now operating as Flip, is a verticalized AI voice agent platform that
automates inbound customer service calls for large consumer businesses. The company is co-founded
and led by Brian Schiff and Sam, who met as freshmen at Cornell University in 2015 and launched the
business in its current form in 2018 after pivoting away from a ride-sharing app they had built
across Upstate New York campuses. As of early 2026, FlipCX has crossed 250 customers, automated 300
million phone calls to date, and is generating revenue well north of $12.5 million ARR on a run rate
basis, with the company confirming it is solidly into eight figures. The business has grown at
roughly 3x year-over-year for the past several years. FlipCX raised an $8.5 million seed round in
late 2021 and closed a $20 million Series A in January 2026 at a valuation of approximately $100
million. The company carries 75 to 78 percent gross margins and has at least one customer paying
over $1 million per year, with ACVs ranging from $50,000 to $500,000. The single most important
strategic fact is FlipCX's deliberate verticalization strategy: rather than building a generic
horizontal AI platform, the company goes deep in transportation, retail e-commerce, and healthcare
urgent care, where 95 percent of any new customer's needed workflows are already built into the
platform out of the box, enabling fast onboarding and compounding network effects within tight
industry networks where trust is the primary growth currency.

marketing and sales and Dylan owning product, and the company has scaled to $1 million in revenue

## [Kirby Corporation][73]

[Learn More][74]

Kirby Corporation is the premier tank barge operator in the United States, transporting bulk liquid
products throughout the Mississippi River System, on the Gulf Intracoastal Waterway, and along all
three U.S. Coasts. Through its Distribution and Services segment, Kirby is also a leading nationwide
service provider and distributor of diesel engines, transmissions, parts, industrial equipment, and
oilfield service equipment.

[][75]
[][76]
[][77]
[][78]
[][79]

## Marine Transportation

Kirby operates the largest inland and offshore tank barge fleets in the United States. The United
States coastline and inland waterway system are one of the most vibrant and efficient transportation
systems in the world, linking the nation’s heartland and coastal states to each other and to the
world. Kirby’s industry leading fleet of inland tank barges transport bulk liquid cargoes, including
petrochemicals, black oil, refined products, and agricultural chemicals for customers on the
Mississippi River, its tributaries, and the Gulf Intracoastal Waterway. Kirby Offshore Marine
transports refined products, black oil, petrochemicals, and dry bulk products including sugar and
coal, along the U.S. coastal network including the Atlantic, Gulf, and Pacific coasts.

[Learn More][80]

## Distribution and Services

Kirby is a leading distributor and services provider to industrial markets, offering customers a
single source for after-market service and parts for engines, transmissions, reduction gears, and
related equipment used in oilfield services, marine, power generation, on-highway, and other
industrial applications. In the oil and gas markets, Kirby serves as a distributor and service
provider for diesel engines, transmissions, and pumps, and manufactures and remanufactures oilfield
service equipment, including pressure pumping units. The Company also manufactures power generation
equipment, specialized electrical distribution and control equipment, high capacity energy
storage/battery systems, and rail car movers. In marine and power generation applications, Kirby
provides after-market service for medium-speed and high-speed diesel engines, reduction gears and
ancillary products. Kirby also sells and rents equipment including generators, and rents
compressors, high capacity lift trucks, and refrigeration trailers for use in a variety of
industrial markets.
[Learn More][81]

## [Kirby Corporation][73]

[Learn More][74]

Kirby Corporation is the premier tank barge operator in the United States, transporting bulk liquid
products throughout the Mississippi River System, on the Gulf Intracoastal Waterway, and along all
three U.S. Coasts. Through its Distribution and Services segment, Kirby is also a leading nationwide
service provider and distributor of diesel engines, transmissions, parts, industrial equipment, and
oilfield service equipment.

[][75]
[][76]
[][77]
[][78]
[][79]

## Marine Transportation

Kirby operates the largest inland and offshore tank barge fleets in the United States. The United
States coastline and inland waterway system are one of the most vibrant and efficient transportation
systems in the world, linking the nation’s heartland and coastal states to each other and to the
world. Kirby’s industry leading fleet of inland tank barges transport bulk liquid cargoes, including
petrochemicals, black oil, refined products, and agricultural chemicals for customers on the
Mississippi River, its tributaries, and the Gulf Intracoastal Waterway. Kirby Offshore Marine
transports refined products, black oil, petrochemicals, and dry bulk products including sugar and
coal, along the U.S. coastal network including the Atlantic, Gulf, and Pacific coasts.

[Learn More][80]

## Distribution and Services

Kirby is a leading distributor and services provider to industrial markets, offering customers a
single source for after-market service and parts for engines, transmissions, reduction gears, and
related equipment used in oilfield services, marine, power generation, on-highway, and other
industrial applications. In the oil and gas markets, Kirby serves as a distributor and service
provider for diesel engines, transmissions, and pumps, and manufactures and remanufactures oilfield
service equipment, including pressure pumping units. The Company also manufactures power generation
equipment, specialized electrical distribution and control equipment, high capacity energy
storage/battery systems, and rail car movers. In marine and power generation applications, Kirby
provides after-market service for medium-speed and high-speed diesel engines, reduction gears and
ancillary products. Kirby also sells and rents equipment including generators, and rents
compressors, high capacity lift trucks, and refrigeration trailers for use in a variety of
industrial markets.

### About Kowa Group

Since its establishment in 1894, Kowa has grown into a multinational Japanese company actively
engaged in various manufacturing and trading activities in the fields of pharmaceutical, life
science and information technology, textiles, machinery and various consumer products. Kowa has
during its long history consistently strived to meet the changing needs, and with its continuing
entrepreneurial initiative is determined to meet the needs of future generations. It is this
commitment to consistency and initiative in an ever-changing world that Kowa vows to carry forward
through each generation.

# About Us

London Maritime Academy, a trade name of London Premier Group UK, provides professional maritime
training courses designed to meet the needs of the global maritime industry.

Based in London and operating to international standards, we offer a wide range of Classroom and
Online courses delivered by experienced maritime experts. Our programmes are mainly delivered in
English, with selected courses also available in French, Spanish, and Arabic.

With key training locations in London and Dubai, and extended training services in major maritime
hubs including Athens, Amsterdam, Barcelona, Kuala Lumpur, Istanbul, and Singapore, we are committed
to supporting maritime professionals worldwide with practical, high-quality training for today’s
dynamic industry.

**Home**

For over 3 decades, Neptunus has delivered reliable engineering and technical solutions across the
marine, offshore, oil & gas, industrial, and defense sectors.

Today, Neptunus has evolved into a comprehensive lifecycle support partner for marine and offshore
fleets combining capital equipment supply, repair & maintenance expertise, and technology-driven
solutions under one integrated platform.

Operating across 30+ countries with 2500+ successful projects delivered, we support clients through
every phase of the asset lifecycle, from shipbuilding and commissioning to operations, maintenance,
modernization, and performance optimization.

With 3 decades of technical expertise spanning operations in 30+ countries, Neptunus is dedicated to
redefining industry standards for engine and propulsion system maintenance.

We are at the forefront of innovation in the marine, oil and gas, industrial, and defense sectors,

**Home**

For over 3 decades, Neptunus has delivered reliable engineering and technical solutions across the
marine, offshore, oil & gas, industrial, and defense sectors.

Today, Neptunus has evolved into a comprehensive lifecycle support partner for marine and offshore
fleets combining capital equipment supply, repair & maintenance expertise, and technology-driven
solutions under one integrated platform.

Operating across 30+ countries with 2500+ successful projects delivered, we support clients through
every phase of the asset lifecycle, from shipbuilding and commissioning to operations, maintenance,
modernization, and performance optimization.

With 3 decades of technical expertise spanning operations in 30+ countries, Neptunus is dedicated to
redefining industry standards for engine and propulsion system maintenance.

We are at the forefront of innovation in the marine, oil and gas, industrial, and defense sectors,

### OVER 180 YEARS OF MARINE HERITAGE

P&O Maritime Logistics is a world leader in marine solutions focused on offshore energy, port
services and cargo transport. As a solutions-focused partner in the DP World family, we provide
customized marine services to connect remote resources to the world markets.

[OUR SERVICES][31]

[Modern and versatile fleet]

### REDEFINING PROJECT CARGO TRANSPORTATION

From inland waterways to offshore wind farms, our flexible and adaptable Module Carrying Vessels
(MCVs) deliver safe, sustainable, and tailored transport solutions for heavy modules and complex
cargo.

Shallow draft. Heavy-lift capability. Exceptional maneuverability. We operate where others cannot.

Wherever your project takes you, we are ready.

[LEARN MORE ABOUT OUR MCV FLEET][32]

### RELIABLE OFFSHORE SUPPORT FOR COMPLEX ENERGY OPERATIONS

We provide end-to-end offshore support vessel (OSV) services and integrated marine logistics to the
global energy industry, supporting complex offshore operations worldwide.

With a modern OSV fleet, highly experienced crews, and strong logistics capability, we deliver safe,
reliable, and efficient offshore support from installation to decommissioning — ensuring operational
continuity across demanding and dynamic maritime environments.

[LEARN MORE][33]

[Our Business Model]

### SEAMLESS PORT OPERATIONS & TRUSTED BULK LOGISTICS

Integrated port operations and bulk logistics that keep global trade moving.

From safe vessel arrival and departure to the transport of minerals, grains, and cement, we connect
complex supply chains through efficient marine and inland solutions.

[EXPLORE OUR CAPABILITIES][34]

### CAREERS

Our people are the driving force behind our global success. From terminal controllers and operations
managers to vessel captains and technical specialists – every role plays a critical part in our
success.

With a geographically diverse workforce, spanning seven continents, we hire and train local talent –
utilizing local resources to strengthen the communities where we operate.

[JOIN US][35]

### SAFETY FIRST ALWAYS

Health, safety and environmental responsibility are at the heart of all that we do.

We hold ourselves – and our partners – to the highest standards.

Safe operations. Sustainable practices. Zero compromise.

[LEARN MORE ABOUT OUR COMMITMENT][36]

##### P&O

P&O Maritime Logistics is a leading provider of marine solutions with focus on offshore energy, port
services and logistics to the global energy industry.

## Let’s build a better world together

PT Duta Marine provide integrated full services operation and maintenance of FSO, FPSO, FPU, MOPU,
FSRU, LNG Carrier, AHTS, Tugboat for offshore and Oil and Gas industries. Duta Marine has
established proven track record for FSO Conversion, Installation and Operation as well.

**September 15th, 2023.**
A historical day. The day when the first gas from MAC field started flowing to gas buyers through
East Java gas pipeline. The day when we could prove that the first Mobile Offshore Production Unit
or MOPU, designed and constructed in Indonesia started processing gas. The MOPU Prameswari 8 is the
result of hardworking of professional teams standing in MAC field in the middle of Madura Strait,
East Java. The project was completed safely with zero accidents.

SOLUTIONS
YOUR TRUSTED PARTNER FOR SHIPBUILDING & MARINE SOLUTIONS
Henan Ruihang Shipbuilding Heavy Industry Co., Ltd.offers a range of customized shipbuilding and
design tailored to the need of different industries,helping customers improve transportation
efficiency,ensure the safety and reliability of the transportation process.
[ Learn More > ][94]
01

## Inland River Combined Bulk & Container Vessels

- Shallow-Water Port Access: Compact, highly maneuverable—fits small ports where large ships can’t
dock, solving issues of poor infrastructure or limited equipment.
- Multi-Cargo Handling: Carries bulk goods (coal, ore, grain) and containers together. No secondary
loading/unloading, boosting efficiency and cutting logistics costs.
- “Bulk-Container Match” Model: One voyage enables "bulk out of island, containers into island".
Optimizes cargo flow, improves vessel use, and reduces overall costs.
02

## Offshore Work Vessels

- High-Precision Build: CCS-certified (China Classification Society). Uses laser cutting, block
construction, and 3D welding robots—enhances quality and production speed.
- Strong Scene Adaptability: Covers offshore engineering, port maintenance, and special work ships.
"River-to-sea" design works in complex offshore areas and connects inland-coastal shipping. Fully
customizable (load, size, power).
03

## Barges

- Custom Solutions: Powered/non-powered, passenger, work, dredging, container barges. Technical
support available. Inquiries welcome.

# We are Seaspan

With more than a century of experience operating up and down the coast of Western Canada, Seaspan
plays a vital role in Canada’s marine sector: designing, building, and repairing ships, and
transporting goods, materials, and fuel safely and efficiently through the Pacific Northwest.

## Seaspan Shipyards

[joint support ships under construction underneath big blue]

Located on the Pacific Northwest Coast, Seaspan’s Shipyards are an important resource for the
region’s marine industry. Seaspan Shipyards operations include Vancouver Shipyards, Vancouver
Drydock and Victoria Shipyards.

[Seaspan Shipyards][42]

## Seaspan Marine

[aerial view of seaspan tugs docked at head office]

Seaspan Marine offers ship assist, coastal and deep-sea transportation, and fuel bunkering services
on Canada’s West Coast, and daily commercial ferry services supporting the Vancouver Island supply
chain.

[Seaspan Marine][43]
[Seaspan Ferries][44]

# Careers at Seaspan

Be part of a winning team

Seaspan is looking for talented employees to apply for rewarding work in the marine transportation
and shipbuilding industry in Metro Vancouver and on Vancouver Island – to fill jobs in our
operations, ashore, management, service and at-sea teams.

Whether you’re a shipbuilder, mariner, tradesperson, project manager, planner, scheduler, engineer,
or are a safety, IT or finance professional, you’ll find a fulfilling career at our amazing
locations.

[Explore Openings][50]

## Community + Culture + Values

WE FOCUS ON PEOPLE, COMMUNITY AND OUR MARINE ENVIRONMENT

With roots tracing back to 1886, Seaspan is a long-standing and proud member of British Columbia’s
maritime community. Guided by our core values of Safety, Care, Efficiency and Accountability, we are
committed to supporting humanitarian causes where we live and work and safeguarding our rivers and
coastal waters.

# We are Seaspan

With more than a century of experience operating up and down the coast of Western Canada, Seaspan
plays a vital role in Canada’s marine sector: designing, building, and repairing ships, and
transporting goods, materials, and fuel safely and efficiently through the Pacific Northwest.

## Seaspan Shipyards

[joint support ships under construction underneath big blue]

Located on the Pacific Northwest Coast, Seaspan’s Shipyards are an important resource for the
region’s marine industry. Seaspan Shipyards operations include Vancouver Shipyards, Vancouver
Drydock and Victoria Shipyards.

[Seaspan Shipyards][42]

## Seaspan Marine

[aerial view of seaspan tugs docked at head office]

Seaspan Marine offers ship assist, coastal and deep-sea transportation, and fuel bunkering services
on Canada’s West Coast, and daily commercial ferry services supporting the Vancouver Island supply
chain.

[Seaspan Marine][43]
[Seaspan Ferries][44]

# Careers at Seaspan

Be part of a winning team

Seaspan is looking for talented employees to apply for rewarding work in the marine transportation
and shipbuilding industry in Metro Vancouver and on Vancouver Island – to fill jobs in our
operations, ashore, management, service and at-sea teams.

Whether you’re a shipbuilder, mariner, tradesperson, project manager, planner, scheduler, engineer,
or are a safety, IT or finance professional, you’ll find a fulfilling career at our amazing
locations.

[Explore Openings][50]

[jacoba portrait]
[seaspan mariner piloting tugboat]

## Community + Culture + Values

WE FOCUS ON PEOPLE, COMMUNITY AND OUR MARINE ENVIRONMENT

With roots tracing back to 1886, Seaspan is a long-standing and proud member of British Columbia’s
maritime community. Guided by our core values of Safety, Care, Efficiency and Accountability, we are
committed to supporting humanitarian causes where we live and work and safeguarding our rivers and
coastal waters.

## INTRODUCTION OF CPT. WITTICH, SEA WOLF MARINE, est 1987

#### SEA WOLF MARINE TRANSPORTATION, LLC

Captain Willie Wittich is a corporate officer of SWM, which is a multi-faceted marine company that
provides beach replenishment, dredging, marine construction, marine logistics, marine
transportation, stevedoring, salvage and emergency towing services worldwide. Captain Wittich has
over forty five years’ experience as a Vessel Master, Salvage Master, Project Manager, Chief
Operating Officer, and Managing Director.

SEA WOLF MARINE TRANSPORTATION, WITTICH SALVAGE, LLC., and SWM Black Sea Division began as a tugboat
company in New York Harbor. The companies have been in continuous operation since 1987. Captain
Wittich has expanded to provide maritime services wherever they may be needed throughout the world.
Sea Wolf Marine wholly owns and operates a fleet of tugboats ranging from 7 to 72-ton Bollard Pull,
along with barges, derricks, and specialized support vessels. They also maintain a marine
fire-fighting and salvage depot coupled with extraction gear, ground tackle and miscellaneous
support equipment. To complement its own equipment, through long-term partners – both domestically
in the United States and internationally, Sea Wolf Marine also has ready access to a multitude of
other vessels and marine equipment to suit the need of any project.

Please find a more detailed list of the company’s capabilities and an Equipment List attached
hereto.

It is our hope that SEA WOLF MARINE can assist you in any future marine based projects you may have.

# Shipbuilding & Ship Repair Shipyard Network

SYM Naval develops tailor-made shipbuilding projects and provides ship repair services through a
network of shipyards operating in Spain, the Dominican Republic and Panama.

[ Contact our team ][52]

## Custom shipbuilding Advanced steel and aluminum shipbuilding

[ Explore Shipbuilding ][53]

SYM Naval designs and builds fully classified steel and aluminum vessels tailored to each client’s
operational needs. Our capabilities cover tugboats, MARPOL units, electric vessels and a wide range
of auxiliary ships, all developed under European engineering standards.

From concept and naval architecture to construction, outfitting and testing, every project is
executed in close coordination with the shipowner. This allows us to deliver vessels that are
efficient, robust and perfectly adapted to their mission profiles, whether in port operations,
environmental services or coastal support.

[
[Tugboats]

### Tugboats

Custom tugboats for port and offshore operations, available in diesel, hybrid or fully electric
configurations.
][54]
[
[MARPOL]

### MARPOL

Harbour ships for MARPOL I, IV, V and VI waste collection, with double hull and capacities up to 230
m³.
][55]
[
[Auxiliary]

### Auxiliary

Multipurpose auxiliary units for port services and coastal support, built under rigorous
shipbuilding standards.
][56]

## Ship repair services Global ship repair and maintenance 

SYM Naval delivers ship repair and maintenance worldwide, supporting vessels in port, at anchorage,
during navigation and in dry dock. Our teams handle steel, mechanical, hydraulic, piping and
electrical repairs with rapid mobilisation and a clear focus on reducing downtime, ensuring
operational continuity and maintaining full compliance across international routes.

[ EXPLORE SHIP REPAIR ][57]

### [ Dry docking ][58]

Dry docking at our facilities or full dry-dock support through partner shipyards worldwide.

### [ Afloat ship repairs ][59]

Repairs in port or at anchorage to keep your vessel moving without delays.

### [ In-navigation repairs ][60]

Riding squads restore mechanical, electrical and hydraulic systems during voyage.

### [ Ship conversion ][61]

Tailor-made retrofits and structural upgrades for evolving operational and regulatory needs.

## Shipyards and Global Coverage Mediterranean, Caribbean and Panama Canal 

[ Explore locations ][62]

SYM Naval operates shipyards in Barcelona and the Dominican Republic, supported by a permanent
technical base in the Panama Canal. This strategic network allows us to deliver fast response,
specialised capabilities and full project execution across key maritime hubs.

With teams positioned along major trade routes, we combine local presence with worldwide reach.
Whether for ship repair, haul-out operations or custom shipbuilding, our infrastructure ensures
reliable support wherever vessels operate.

# Shipbuilding & Ship Repair Shipyard Network

SYM Naval develops tailor-made shipbuilding projects and provides ship repair services through a
network of shipyards operating in Spain, the Dominican Republic and Panama.

[ Contact our team ][52]

## Custom shipbuilding Advanced steel and aluminum shipbuilding

[ Explore Shipbuilding ][53]

SYM Naval designs and builds fully classified steel and aluminum vessels tailored to each client’s
operational needs. Our capabilities cover tugboats, MARPOL units, electric vessels and a wide range
of auxiliary ships, all developed under European engineering standards.

From concept and naval architecture to construction, outfitting and testing, every project is
executed in close coordination with the shipowner. This allows us to deliver vessels that are
efficient, robust and perfectly adapted to their mission profiles, whether in port operations,
environmental services or coastal support.

[
[Tugboats]

### Tugboats

Custom tugboats for port and offshore operations, available in diesel, hybrid or fully electric
configurations.
][54]
[
[MARPOL]

### MARPOL

Harbour ships for MARPOL I, IV, V and VI waste collection, with double hull and capacities up to 230
m³.
][55]
[
[Auxiliary]

### Auxiliary

Multipurpose auxiliary units for port services and coastal support, built under rigorous
shipbuilding standards.
][56]

## Ship repair services Global ship repair and maintenance 

SYM Naval delivers ship repair and maintenance worldwide, supporting vessels in port, at anchorage,
during navigation and in dry dock. Our teams handle steel, mechanical, hydraulic, piping and
electrical repairs with rapid mobilisation and a clear focus on reducing downtime, ensuring
operational continuity and maintaining full compliance across international routes.

[ EXPLORE SHIP REPAIR ][57]

### [ Dry docking ][58]

Dry docking at our facilities or full dry-dock support through partner shipyards worldwide.

### [ Afloat ship repairs ][59]

Repairs in port or at anchorage to keep your vessel moving without delays.

### [ In-navigation repairs ][60]

Riding squads restore mechanical, electrical and hydraulic systems during voyage.

### [ Ship conversion ][61]

Tailor-made retrofits and structural upgrades for evolving operational and regulatory needs.

## Shipyards and Global Coverage Mediterranean, Caribbean and Panama Canal 

[ Explore locations ][62]

SYM Naval operates shipyards in Barcelona and the Dominican Republic, supported by a permanent
technical base in the Panama Canal. This strategic network allows us to deliver fast response,
specialised capabilities and full project execution across key maritime hubs.

With teams positioned along major trade routes, we combine local presence with worldwide reach.
Whether for ship repair, haul-out operations or custom shipbuilding, our infrastructure ensures
reliable support wherever vessels operate.

### An Alternative Path to Growing Lasting, Private Companies

#### We believe in the vital importance of humans coming together to create and grow enduring,
#### private businesses that make a dent in the universe.

### Capitalism at its Best™

## The Evergreen Entrepreneur

#### The leaders of these enduring businesses are seasoned entrepreneurs and CEOs with the vision,
#### creativity, resourcefulness, patience and grit to build and scale a business that will stay
#### private indefinitely.

## The Evergreen 7Ps

##### Purpose

Having a compelling reason for existing - a North Star above all else.

##### Perseverance

Having the ambition and the resilience to overcome obstacles and keep pursuing the purpose
indefinitely into the future.

##### People First

Engaging a workforce of talented associates who excel as a team and are motivated by the purpose and
the culture, as well as by total compensation, in the belief that, by taking care of them, they will
take care of the customers, suppliers, partners, communities, and their families.

##### Profit

Not mistaking profit as the purpose of the business; but recognizing it is essential to survival and
independence, and the most accurate measure of customer value delivered.

##### Private

Taking advantage of the ability of closely-held private companies to have a longer-term view,
greater confidentiality around strategies, and more operating flexibility than public or
exit-oriented businesses.

##### Paced Growth

Having the discipline to focus on long term strategy, balance short term and long term performance,
and grow steadily and consistently from year to year.

##### Pragmatic Innovation

Embracing a continuous-improvement process built around taking capital efficient, calculated risks
to innovate creatively within constraints.

## Our Community

### The [Tugboat Institute][12], a membership organization, brings together Evergreen CEOs across
### industry sectors to share best practices and unique insights, and to develop trusted bonds for
### their respective Evergreen Journeys.

## Connecting Evergreen Leaders

### Our annual invitation-only Tugboat Summit is dedicated to Evergreen CEOs. Short presentations
### and small group discussions focus on a range of topics from scaling great cultures to building
### great brands.

## Engaging Evergreen Exemplars

### Established Evergreen companies host us at their headquarters to talk candidly about the unique
### strengths and common challenges associated with running a privately held company.

 

#### “I’m pleased that Tugboat is supporting businesses with the same Evergreen principles that have
#### served SAS so well for 38 years.”

 

#### *Dr. Jim Goodnight, CEO SAS Institute*


## Give and Take

### All members are encouraged to contribute their best practices and knowledge of building and
### sustaining an Evergreen business and Evergreen family. The broader community can enjoy some of
### this insightful and inspiring content through our [Evergreen Journal.][13]

# About Our Company

Dutch Thrustleader Marine Propulsion (Jiangsu) Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of the Dutch brand Dutch
Thrustleader, founded in 2007 in the Netherlands and established in China in 2017 to meet growing
global demand. The company integrates R&D, engineering, and manufacturing, leveraging advanced
Chinese industrial resources. With a 10,000 m² production area, our facility includes specialized
assembly and testing workshops. We are certified under GB/T19001-2016 / ISO9001:2015 and hold CCS
and BV factory accreditations. Our R&D center is supported by two postdoctoral advisors and a team
of experienced European and Chinese engineers. We design and manufacture a wide range of marine
propulsion systems, including tunnel thrusters, azimuth thrusters, deck-mounted and retractable
azimuth thrusters, along with advanced control systems. Power output ranges from 30 kW to 6000 kW,
with integration options for dynamic positioning systems. For the renewable energy sector, we offer
battery-powered and hybrid propulsion systems, unmanned vessel control solutions, and customized pod
thrusters. All systems can be delivered under major classification societies such as CCS, DNV-GL,
LR, ABS, BV, RINA, NK, RMRS, and CRS. Our mission is to build Dutch Thrustleader into a world-class
brand—customer-focused, reliable, and innovative.

# Deploy with confidence

Data-first testing and review environments within a mighty serverless platform.

[Get Started for FREE][14][Book a Demo][15]
Trusted by:
[Digital Services Georgie Logo]

## Designed for Developers

Complex deployments used to require an entire DevOps team. Welcome to declarative infrastructure and
services for just about every frontend and backend framework under the Linux sun.

**Infrastructure as code. **There’s no deployment process to learn with Tugboat—your team works
right in Git, declaring the infrastructure services you need when you need them. Hasta la vista,
config drift!
‍

**Elegant and flexible developer tools galore**! Interact with Tugboat from your terminal with the
CLI, or send API requests to integrate a larger workflow. Or shell into a service straight from the
dashboard.

Whatever floats your boat.

## Test & Deploy

Supplement your existing CI/CD with critical last-mile audits and turn error-prone manual reviews
into fool-proof deployments. All while maintaining a best-in-class DevOps practice regardless of
where you host.

#### Self-service ephemeral infrastructure

#### Visual Regression testing

#### Google Lighthouse
#### integration

#### GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, & Git

#### Shell access, CLI, API

#### Email & Log capture

## Why Tugboat?

Versatile, scalable infrastructure options to supercharge your team's abilties.
* Deploy previews for every pull request, automatically.
* Infrastructure you need, when you need it.
* End-to-end visibility throughout the development process.
* Real data. Real fast.
  ‍
* Simple, flat pricing. Unlimited users and unlimited previews.
* Flexible workflows that match the way your team works.

### Deploy anywhere!

You have full control of your previews - *and* where you host.
* AWS
* Akamai Cloud
* Pantheon
* Heroku
* Google Cloud
* WP Cloud
* Platform
* Acquia

On-Premise for enterprise

We also offer on-premise options for security-conscious organizations.

# Perpetual brainstorming for the finest logistics solutions that fit customer needs...


Our commitment to innovation, creativity, and adaptability enables us to deliver tailored logistics
services that go beyond conventional approaches.

## To develop logistics solutions that truly fit customer needs, we prioritize understanding our
## clients on a deep level.

### Supply Chain Solutions

In Ülgen, we possess extensive supply chain knowledge that enables us to optimize every aspect of
our clients' supply chains. From demand forecasting and inventory management to supplier
relationships and distribution network design, our expertise ensures streamlined operations, reduced
costs, and enhanced customer satisfaction.

[Learn More][30]

### Logistic Solutions

Ülgen takes pride in its team of highly skilled professionals who possess superior knowledge in
optimizing supply chain processes. With expertise in areas such as inventory management, route
optimization, and customs regulations, we ensure seamless operations, cost-efficiency, and timely
delivery for our clients.

[Learn More][31]

### Commodities

In Ülgen, we specialize in handling a diverse range of commodities, including perishable goods such
as fresh produce and pharmaceuticals, ensuring their timely delivery while maintaining optimal
storage conditions. Additionally, we are equipped to transport heavy machinery and industrial
equipment, providing efficient and secure solutions for clients in the manufacturing and
construction sectors.

[Learn More][32]

### Our Fleet

Ülgen boasts a superior fleet comprising of state-of-the-art vehicles equipped with advanced
tracking systems, ensuring real-time visibility and security for our clients' shipments. With a
diverse range of vehicles including trucks, vans, and specialized transporters, we have the
flexibility and capacity to handle a wide variety of cargo, delivering it safely and efficiently to
its destination.

[Learn More][33]

### Data Analytics

By embracing data analytics in the logistics industry, we can unlock new levels of efficiency,
agility, and competitiveness. It allows us to make proactive decisions, optimize resources, mitigate
risks, and ultimately deliver superior logistics solutions to our clients. Partner with us today to
experience the transformative power of data analytics in the logistics industry and take your supply
chain to new heights of success.

[Learn More][34]

# **Ultranav**

**Ultranav **is a privately owned group of shipping companies with offices in 21 countries. We
operate through twelve businesses in five market segments: Tankers, gas, dry bulk, coastal trades
and towage & offshore. **
**

**We operate** a fleet of gas and chemical carriers, tankers for crude oil and clean petroleum
products, bulk carriers, feeder container ships, multipurpose vessels, harbour tugs, PSVs, AHTS
vessels, pusher tugs, barges and pilot boats.

**We aim** to support customers and partners in those segments and niches where we can develop
long-term sustainable competitive advantages by adding value to our customers. We focus on customers
who value mutually beneficial long-term relationships. Ultranav has a flexible organisation managed
by qualified professionals committed to providing the best services to the satisfaction of our
customers.

## **Ultranav **highlights

### Every ton of CO2 counts

Our entire group of shipping companies has been involved in an internal sustainability initiative
centered around our guiding principle: “Every ton counts”. We have gathered our collective
knowledge, perspectives and opinions on how we can reduce CO2 emissions and move closer to achieving
our shared goal of net zero emissions by 2050. 

[Read more][24]

### Join the best team!

When you join Ultranav, you don’t just get a bunch of new colleagues. You get a second family. We
value a positive and open atmosphere and we truly care about each other. Want to be part of the
Ultranav family? Check out our open positions.

[Read more][25]


### Decarbonisation of the shipping industry

Ultranav is committed to a cleaner future and we strive to play an active role in exceeding IMO’s
mandatory targets of reducing CO2 intensity by at least 40% until 2030 and total GHG emissions by
50% until 2050.

[Read more][26]

## **Ultranav **businesses**
## **

[[Ultrabulk website link]][27]

**Ultrabulk **is a dry bulk operator servicing its customers in the Panamax, Supramax, Handysize
segments as well as Specialised Services.

[[Navigator Gas website link]][28]

**Navigator Gas** is the owner and operator of the world’s largest fleet of handysize liquefied gas
carriers.

[[Cape Tankers website link]][29]

**Southern Cross CT** is part of Panamax International and Aframax International, both trading
platforms in the Americas for dirty petroleum products in their respective segments, the two managed
by Cape Tankers, also part of Ultranav.

[[Austral Product Tankers website link]][30]

**Austral Product Tankers** is part of the CPTA joint venture, a world leading MR product tanker
operator.

[[Ultratank website link]][31]

**Ultratank **operates a modern fleet of chemical tankers, trading between North, Central and South
America.

[[Horizon website link]][32]

**Horizon** is a leading bulk dry cargo operator, specialized in transportation of concentrates,
such as copper and zinc.

[Ultranav Chile website link]

**Ultranav Chile **owns and operates various vessel types involved in Chilean cabotage and regional
trades.

[[Antares Naviera website link]][33]

**Antares Naviera **is an Argentinean shipowner and operator providing cabotage services for crude
oil and refined products.

[[Naviera Transoceánica website link]][34]

**Naviera Transoceánica (Navitranso)** is a Peruvian ship owner and operator providing cabotage
services for crude oil, refined products, LPG and chemicals.

**International Shipowning **owns and manages vessels chartered out to various Ultranav operating
businesses, particularly in the tanker segments.

[[Ultratug website link]][35]

**Ultratug **operates offshore vessels, harbor and terminal tugs, servicing 40 ports in 7 countries
in Latin America.

[[Wilson Sons Ultratug Offshore website link]][36]

**Wilson Sons Ultratug Offshore **has one of the largest and most modern offshore support vessel
fleets in Brazil. It offers maritime support to oil and gas extraction and production platforms.

cutting-edge solutions while always prioritizing safety and efficiency. Moreover, our highly

excellence.

superior quality services to our valued clients.

Ultratug announces a single brand in all countries where it has presence. Simplifying its message to

# Ultratug

Ultratug is where tradition meets innovation in the world of maritime towage.

With over five decades of firm commitment to excellence, we have established ourselves as one of the
leading operators in the harbour towage, salvage, and offshore industry in the main countries of
South America and Mexico, with a significant growth potential in other Central American and
Caribbean countries.

What sets us apart is our ability to seamlessly blend our consistent knowledge and experience with
cutting-edge solutions while always prioritizing safety and efficiency. Moreover, our highly
professional team is passionate and committed to their work, constantly training to achieve
excellence.

We pride ourselves on being **a partner you can trust**, offering first-class assistance and
superior quality services to our valued clients.

## Coverage

Ultratug announces a single brand in all countries where it has presence. Simplifying its message to
the market, the operations in Chile, Peru, Ecuador, Colombia, Panama, Mexico, Argentina, and Uruguay
are now recognized under a single brand **ULTRATUG**.

## STEMS

#### SMART TUG ENERGY MANAGEMENT SYSTEM

Developed by NAVTEK Naval Technologies Inc., with the objective of optimizing the electric power
consumption, extending ZEETUG’s operational range and battery lifetime.

 

The first application of STEMS has been performed on GİSAŞ POWER (ZEETUG30) @2019. Which is the
first zero emission, re-chargeable and full electric tugboat in the world.

 

STEMS is both a browser-based and a mobile software, which has a lot of capabilities for fleet
control center and tugboat operators. With its flexible structure, it can be adapted to a fleet.

 

STEMS collects all data coming from the devices and equipment in the tugboat and stores them in the
Control Center’s server. It uses the related data to performance, to optimize the electric power… 


 
* Tug speed, 
* Motor speed, 
* Power consumption, 
* Battery motor temperature, 
* Battery state of charge, 
* Actual ambient condition’s data, 
* Weather data, 
* Route 
* The position and the other facts (speed draft) of the ship that shall be assisted 
* Charging station occupation
   

ADVANTAGES

 
* STEMS can be used on more than one ZEETUG® (a whole fleet) 
* Towage operations can be scheduled on considering the availability of the charged (ready to
  operate) ZEETUG®. 
* The final charge of batteries can be estimated. 
* Both the control center operator and the tugboat operator can change predefined route on chart. 
* Any type of Android mobile tablet (personnel or industrial type) can be used. 
* All data coming from the ZEETUG® are being stored in the control center servers. 
* STEMS can prepare reports of all operational output. 
* Due to the possible operation profile changes the software can be revised.

 

FEATURES

 
* A single platform to control the entire ZEETUG® fleet. 
* Integration with Marine Traffic charts. 
* Collecting data coming from all devices and equipment of the electric tugboats and storing them in
  the server. 
* Displaying real-time wind data from ground stations 
* Monitoring all relevant data related to performance of the tugboats and giving feedbacks. 
* Charging time estimation by considering the battery’ state of health 
* Reporting tools for operation and personnel performance 
* Ready for online diagnostic & maintenance
   

QCS

## QCS

#### Quick Charge Station (QCS)

The Quick Charge Station is designed (tailor-made) for ZEETUG® by NAVTEK NAVAL TECHNOLOGIES INC.

 

Charging ZEETUG is an easy process! You simply plug ZEETUG® into a charger that is connected to the
Quick Charge Station.

 

The time it takes to charge a ZEETUG® varies based on the charger you use like other electrical
devices.

 

We adjust the technical characteristics of ZEETUG® according to the existing operational profile and
needs/requirements of our clients.
